verses.text: A dry bite of bread in peace beats a house full of food and fighting.
A servant who acts wisely will rule over a son who brings shame and share the inheritance with the brothers.
A crucible refines silver and a furnace refines gold. The LORD tests hearts.
Someone who does evil listens to wicked talk. A liar pays attention to words that stir up trouble.
Mock the poor and you insult their Maker. Celebrate someone's disaster and you won't get away with it.
Grandchildren are a crown to the old, and children take pride in their parents.
Fine speech doesn't suit a fool. Lies suit a ruler even less.
To the one who gives it, a bribe looks like a precious gem. Wherever they turn, things seem to go their way.
Let an offense go and you make room for love. Keep bringing it up and you split up close friends.
One correction goes deeper into someone with understanding than a hundred lashes go into a fool.
An evil person seeks nothing but rebellion, so a cruel messenger will be sent against them.
You're better off meeting a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool caught up in foolishness.
Pay back good with evil, and evil won't leave your house.
Starting a fight is like cracking open a dam. Drop the dispute before the argument breaks out.
The LORD detests both letting the wicked off and condemning people who do what's right.
Why give a fool money to buy wisdom when they have no understanding?
A friend loves through everything. A brother is born for hard times.
Someone with no judgment shakes hands on a deal and puts themselves up as collateral for their neighbor.
Love rebellion and you love a fight. Build your gate too high and you're asking for ruin.
A crooked heart won't find prosperity. A deceitful tongue lands its owner in trouble.
Being the parent of a fool brings grief. The father of a fool has no joy.
A cheerful heart is good medicine. A crushed spirit dries up the bones.
The wicked take bribes in secret to bend justice.
Someone with understanding keeps wisdom in view. A fool's eyes wander to the ends of the earth.
A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the mother who gave birth to him.
It's wrong to punish people who do right or to lash officials for their integrity.
People who know what they're talking about use few words. A calm temper shows understanding.
Even a fool seems wise when they stay quiet. Keep your mouth shut and people will think you have good judgment.
